summary: Iteration 2: tested new profile features (change-password, change-email, /auth/account), Landing 'Esempi' section, forgot-password Resend flow, and quick login regression. Backend: 10/10 pytest tests PASS. Frontend: profile navigation via avatar menu, wrong-password Italian error toast, successful change-password + change-email with UI update all PASS. Landing 'Esempi' section renders 3 book cards with cover images. Seed user test@libroteca.ai/Test1234! (12 credits) untouched — throwaway users used for mutating tests.
critical_code_review_comments: Profile.jsx: line 42 useEffect swallows /auth/account errors silently (empty .catch); consider setting a fallback state or logging so unauthenticated/failure cases surface to the user.
server.py:718 change_email updates email without checking for empty string/whitespace-only after strip; consider min length validation. Current basic '@' + '.' check is minimal.

server.py forgot_password: reset_link uses `Origin` header without validating against allowed origins — could be manipulated to include attacker origins in reset emails. Consider constraining to APP_URL env var or an allow-list.

server.py change_email returns User(**updated) but doesn't invalidate existing sessions/tokens after email change; user cookies still have old email in JWT payload (verify if JWT contains email/user_id — if only user_id, OK).
Profile.jsx change-password success handler does not refresh /auth/account after has_password toggles (only local state updated); minor since UI is optimistic.
test_credentials: test@libroteca.ai / Test1234! (verified intact after all tests, 12 credits)
seed_data_creation: None. Created transient throwaway registered users via /api/auth/register during tests (test_prof_*@libroteca.ai and ui_prof_*@libroteca.ai). No cleanup applied — accumulate in DB.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Auth uses httpOnly cookies (access_token, refresh_token) NOT bearer tokens returned in JSON — use requests.Session() for backend tests. Register endpoint returns only user info; cookies are set on session. Resend runs in testing mode: only alessandro.ledda@tempocasa.com receives emails; other addresses get error logged but API returns 200 (correct behavior). Landing '/Esempi' uses data-testid=example-book-{0,1,2}. Profile page /profilo requires auth; data-testids present. Login form data-testids: login-email-input/login-password-input/login-submit and register-name-input/register-email-input/register-password-input.
